Taha says he never heard back from Joe, but a year later he turned on the radio and heard "Rock the Casbah," which stylistically resembled much of what he had given Joe that night. "Was Rock the Casbah inspired by what was handed to Joe on the sidewalk that night in Paris? Well, maybe."
